$comment: CANONICAL, single source of truth for Hermes compatibility policy. Every layer (renderer src/lib/hermes/compat.ts, electron/hermes-compat.cjs, scripts/plugin-sdk-contract.mjs, the Python plugin contract, and installer/bootstrap/Release) is asserted against this file by src/lib/hermes-compat-policy.test.ts. Edit HERE first, then update the mirrors the test names.

communityEngine.note: Temporary immutable community runtime while the WhatsApp observer and related fixes are reviewed upstream. The installer verifies the exact SHA and the desktop updater refuses to mutate pinned/fork installs.

releaseChannel.note: Upstream release TAGS are CalVer (vYYYY.M.D) and are NOT the package version. The authoritative semver a release installs is __version__ in hermes_cli/__init__.py at that tag — exactly what `hermes --version` reports. NEVER parse the tag as semver and NEVER scrape release prose. The thin installer reads the source __version__ per candidate tag (Release.ps1: Get-ReleaseSourceVersion) and, when that read is unavailable, falls back to the pinned map below.
releaseChannel.installerContract: The official scripts/install.ps1 accepts -Tag (precedence Commit > Tag > Branch); the bootstrap pins by CalVer tag and verifies the installer blob before running it.

trustAndUpdateProcess: When Hermes ships a new release: (1) read hermes_cli/__init__.py __version__ at the new tag, (2) if it is still in range, add {tag, version} to pinnedReleases here AND to installer/lib/Release.ps1 Get-DefaultPinnedReleases, (3) if a new version widens support, bump range/minVersion/maxVersionExclusive here and in the mirrors this file's test enumerates, and re-verify the plugin's installed-contract tests against it. The drift test fails until every mirror matches, so the policy can never fork silently.
